q: John Newton asinga kumanyibwa lwa ki?
a: Ye yawandiika "Amazing Grace", olunyiriri lwalwo olusooka — "Amazing grace! how sweet the sound, that saved a wretch like me" — nga kye kimu ku bigambo ebisinga okuyimbibwa mu lulimi Olungereza. Eri Newton ekigambo "wretch" (omwonoonyi omunaku) tekyali kusukkiriza kwa muyimbi wabula byafaayo bye eby'amazima ebyereere, kubanga yali muddusi, omuvumi, era omuduumizi w'emmeeri ez'abaddu ekisa nga tekinnamusanga. Ajjukirwa era ng'omusumba Omwangalikani n'omuwandiisi w'ebbaluwa eyafuuka, mu bukadde bwe, omujulizi ayogera obutakweka ng'awakanya obusuubuzi bw'abaddu bwennyini bwe yali akoze edda.

q: John Newton ddala yali musuubuzi wa baddu?
a: Yee, era obwesimbu bwetaagisa okukyolekera butereevu. Oluvannyuma lw'ekiseera eky'ennaku ku lubalama lwa Afirika — gye yali ye kennyini kumpi afa enjala era ng'ayisibwa kumpi ng'omuddu — yalinnya mu busuubuzi obwo, ng'aduumira emmeeri ez'abaddu Duke of Argyle mu 1750 ne African okuva mu 1752 okutuuka mu 1754, ng'atwala abantu abasibiddwa mu njegere wansi w'ekyombo kye kimu kwe yakuumiranga empisa z'eddiini. Ekyeraliikiriza, kino kyagenda mu maaso okumala emyaka oluvannyuma lw'omuyaga gwa 1748 ogwatandika okukyuka kwe; omwoyo gwe ogw'omunda ku buddu bwennyini gwazuukuka mpolampola era oluvannyuma ennyo, era eyo y'ensonga lwaki okwenenya kwe okw'oluvannyuma kwalina obuzito obwenkanidde awo.

q: Okukyuka kwa John Newton kwatandika kutya?
a: Nga 10 March 1748, ku mmeeri y'obusuubuzi Greyhound eyali ekomawo nga esomoka Atlantic, Newton yakwatibwa omuyaga ogw'amaanyi ku lubalama lwa Donegal ogwali kumpi okumenya emmeeri. Ng'asibiddwa ku ppampu okumala essaawa empanvu ng'amazzi gayingira, omusajja eyali afudde okuduulira eddiini omuzannyo yakaabirira Katonda okumusaasira omulundi ogusooka n'omutima gwonna. Emmeeri yawonawo, era yakuuma olunaku olwo ng'olunaku lwe olw'amazaalibwa ag'omwoyo obulamu bwe bwonna, ng'awandiika nti: "Olunaku 10 (kwe kugamba mu nkola eya kaakati 21) olwa March, lwe lunaku olw'okujjukirwa ennyo nange."

q: John Newton yafuuka Omukristaayo omulundi gumu mu muyaga ogwo?
a: Nedda, era yeegendereza obutaleka muntu yenna kulowooza bw'atyo. Newton bulijjo yakakasa nti okukyuka kwe kwali kwa mpolampola, si kwa mbagirawo — omuyaga gwamuzuukusa, naye okukakasibwa okw'amaanyi kwajja mpolampola okumala emyaka, ne bwe yali ng'akyaduumira emmeeri ez'abaddu. Olugero lwe si lwa kununulibwa okulongoofu era okw'amangu, wabula bujulizi nti Katonda akolera ku muntu ow'amazima mu biseera eby'amazima, ekitangaala nga kikya mu mutima ng'ekibi ekinene kikyafuula emikono eddugavu.

q: Omuseeyeeyi eyabadde yatuuka atya okuba omusumba e Olney?
a: Oluvannyuma lw'obulwadde bwa nkukunala okukomya obusobozi bwe obw'obuduumizi nga mu 1754, Newton yafuuka omupima w'amayengo ku mwalo gwa Liverpool era mu ssaawa ze ez'okuwummulamu n'eyeeyigiriza Oluyonaani, Olwebbulaniya n'eby'obwakatonda. Yanoonya okwawulibwa mu Kkanisa ya England era mu kusooka n'agaanibwa, naye nga 29 April 1764 yayawulibwa okuba dikoni, ne mu June eyo kasisi, n'atumibwa ng'omusumba omuyambi mu kabuga akatono ka Olney mu Buckinghamshire, gye yaweereza okumala emyaka nga kkumi n'omukaaga. Mu 1780 yasenguka n'afuuka omusumba omukulu owa St Mary Woolnoth mu City of London, gye yabuuliriza okutuuka kumpi n'enkomerero y'obulamu bwe.

q: Newton yawandiika ddi "Amazing Grace", era lwaki?
a: Yaluwandiika ku mukolo gw'olunaku olw'Omwaka Omuggya e Olney nga 1 January 1773, okwagatta ku kubuulira ku kusaba kwa Kabaka Dawudi okw'okwewuunya mu 1 Ebyomumirembe. Yaluyita "Faith's Review and Expectation", era oluvannyuma lwokka ensi lwe yajja okulumanya olw'ebigambo byalwo ebibiri ebisooka. Lwafulumizibwa mu Olney Hymns eza 1779, ekitabo Newton mwe yawaayo ennyimba nga 280.

q: Omukwano gwa Newton ne poeti William Cowper gwali gutya?
a: E Olney, Newton yafuuka omusumba ow'okumpi era mukwano gwa poeti William Cowper, eyabonaabonanga n'ennaku ey'amaanyi eyaddiŋŋananga n'ebiseera eby'okuggwaamu essuubi okutuuka n'okwagala okwetta. Bombi baawukananga mu bunono — Newton omulundi gumu yajjukira nti "Nzikiriza … tetwamala ssaawa musanvu nga tetuli wamu" — era n'aleeta Cowper mu kuwandiika ennyimba ekitundu ng'eddagala eri omutima ogwali gweruma. Obwegatta bwabwe bwazaala Olney Hymns eza 1779, Cowper mwe yawaayo ennyimba nga nkaaga mu munaana, nga mu zo mwe muli "God moves in a mysterious way."

q: Newton yali ayogeddeko ng'awakanya obusuubuzi bw'abaddu bwe yali afunamu edda?
a: Yee, era n'obuzito omuyiiya yenna bwe yali tasobola kwenkanankana. Mu 1788 yafulumya Thoughts upon the African Slave Trade, okwatula okw'olukale n'okuloopa ng'omujulizi eyalaba ku busuubuzi bwe yali aduumidde edda, era omwaka ogwo gwe gumu n'awa obujulizi mu maaso g'akakiiko ka Privy Council akaali kakebera obusuubuzi obwo. Nga yali alabye entiisa yaabwo n'amaaso ge, yabuwakanya mu bujulizi bwe awatali kwerekereza.

q: Newton yakola ki mu lutalo lwa William Wilberforce okulwanyisa obuddu?
a: William Wilberforce omuvubuka, eyali akyakyuse, bwe yalowooza okuva mu by'obufuzi n'agenda mu buweereza mu 1785, Newton ye yamukubiriza okusigala mu bulamu obw'olukale. Okubuulirira okwo kwayamba Wilberforce okusigala mu House of Commons, gye yakulembera olutalo oluwanvu olw'omu palamenti okulwanyisa obusuubuzi obwo. Newton yawangaala okumala okulaba ekibala kyakwo: etteeka erya Slave Trade Act eryaggyawo obusuubuzi bw'abaddu obwa Bungereza lyayita mu 1807, emyezi mitono gyokka nga tannafa.

q: Obufumbo bwa Newton ne Mary bwali butya, era obulamu bwe bwakoma butya?
a: Okwewaayo kwa Newton eri mukyala we, Mary Catlett — gwe yayitanga Polly — kwayita mu bulamu bwe bwonna, era okufa kwe mu 1790 kwamuleka ng'amuwangaako emyaka kkumi na musanvu. Yafiira mu London nga 21 December 1807, ng'aweza emyaka kinaana mu bbiri, ng'alagidde nti tewaba jjinja lya kijjukizo limulambika okuggyako ebigambo bye yeewandiikira: ekijjukizo ekimwogerako nga "eyali edda atakkiriza era omwenkanya, omuweereza w'abaddu mu Afirika," eyali "olw'okusaasira okungi okwa Mukama waffe era Omulokozi Yesu Kristo, akuumibwa, azzibwa obuggya, asonyiyibwa, era alondebwa okubuulira okukkiriza kwe yamala ebbanga ddene ng'afuba okuzikiriza." Abo abaali okumpi naye ku nkomerero baawa ekigambo ekyangu n'okusingawo — nti yali mwonoonyi mukulu, ne Kristo Omulokozi omukulu.
